name: Krog Street Tunnel
lightingNotes: VERIFY: shaded inside; the cleanest light is at the two openings.
accessNotes: VERIFY: public underpass with car and foot traffic. Bring a spotter.

name: Jackson Street Bridge
lightingNotes: VERIFY: skyline faces west, so sunset backlights the city.
accessNotes: VERIFY: narrow public sidewalk that gets crowded at sunset.

name: Historic Fourth Ward Park
lightingNotes: VERIFY: pond and lawn give soft, even light in the evening.
accessNotes: VERIFY: city park. Check whether paid shoots need a permit.

name: Piedmont Park
lightingNotes: VERIFY: open meadow with a skyline view; little shade at midday.
accessNotes: VERIFY: Piedmont Park Conservancy has rules for commercial photography.

name: Ponce City Market (exterior)
lightingNotes: VERIFY: brick facade glows warm late in the day.
accessNotes: VERIFY: private property. Ask management before any paid shoot.
